incidents.eventDescription: High-severity frontal collision confirmed between V-001 (Sedan) and V-002 (SUV) at 12.2s. Structural deformation detected on frontal crumple zone with 38% spatial hull encroachment.

vehicleAssessments.visibleDamageAssessment: Driver-Side Front Quarter Panel & A-Pillar: 86.4% Impact Deformation (62.2 cm estimated crush depth)
vehicleAssessments.assessmentNotes: Automated Campbell/CRASH3 & Visual Aspect Compression Engine: Delta-V 608.0 px/s produced 86.4% plastic crush depth (62.2 cm) in Driver-Side Front Quarter Panel & A-Pillar with structural integrity calculated at 13.6%.

vehicleAssessments.visibleDamageAssessment: Frontal Bumper & Radiator Crumple Zone: 60.3% Impact Deformation (43.4 cm estimated crush depth)
vehicleAssessments.assessmentNotes: Automated Campbell/CRASH3 & Visual Aspect Compression Engine: Delta-V 449.8 px/s produced 60.3% plastic crush depth (43.4 cm) in Frontal Bumper & Radiator Crumple Zone with structural integrity calculated at 39.7%.
